nodes.text: Betodkar said there's no need to panic, as HMPV behaves similarly to influenza or common viral flu. To monitor the situation, the directorate of health services will intensify surveillance for Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) and Influenza-like Illness (ILI).
